articles.title: ED raids Ramnandi Hotels across 9 locations in alleged Rs 132-crore bank fraud case
articles.summary: The Enforcement Directorate searched nine locations across three states in an alleged bank fraud case. Ramnandi Hotels and Resorts Ltd is accused of diverting Rs 58 crore from bank loans.

articles.title: Spider-Man, Batman all had to pay rent: Magnus Carlsen, now a father, is no exception
articles.summary: Magnus Carlsen’s transition into fatherhood has reshaped how he approaches chess, work and time. Despite unprecedented success, he still sees himself as a provider, balancing the joy of raising his son with the demands of a global career.

articles.title: xQc Explains NoPixel Absences: Co-owner says some GTA RP stars self-excluded; others moved on
articles.summary: xQc has addressed the absence of several major GTA RP streamers from NoPixel 5.0, including Summit1G and Chang Gang members. The NoPixel co-owner said some players chose to leave the server and build their own community, while others had previously criticized NoPixel.

articles.title: Stock market today: BSE Sensex tanks over 650 points, NSE Nifty50 opens below 23,300
articles.summary: Oil prices extended gains on Friday, with Brent and WTI on track to finish the week above $100 a barrel for the first time since mid-May, as attacks along key Middle East shipping routes raised concerns over prolonged supply disruptions. Brent crude was trading at $107.70 a barrel, up 0.03%, while WTI stood at $102.50.

articles.title: Gold, Silver Rate Today Live Updates: Gold heads for third weekly loss as US rate hike bets strengthen
articles.summary: Gold prices edged higher during the session, but remained on track for a third consecutive weekly decline as expectations of a US rate hike strengthened. Spot gold rose 0.2% to $4,324.79 per ounce, but was still down more than 2% for the week so far.
